title: Beg Less Commonly Taught Language I; Vietnamese I
department: School of Languages, Literatures and Cultures
description: First year Vietnamese is a Big Ten Academic Alliance Course-Share course. The instructor is at Michigan State University, but you enroll and receive credit for it at Maryland. You will also need to be entered into the Michigan State University course management system Desire to Learn (D2L). For more information about this course, including textbook information and instructions on enrolling in D2L, please see https://goo.gl/yoEbEm. Heritage speakers and those with prior knowledge of Vietnamese need to contact the Course Coordinator at MSU before enrolling in the course to determine appropriate placement, Ms. Steider: steider@msu.edu, 517-355-5105.
